description: Returns what was recorded since a given date (default 7 days, up to 90): SEC filings accepted, figures a company restated, technical signals logged, and ownership declarations. By default (`highlights`) the window is ranked by materiality — restatements, earnings, material agreements, offerings and sizeable insider purchases first, technical signals last — with repeated items grouped on one line (a company's insider filings of one kind with their total amount, a manager's 13F declarations); `detail: 'events'` returns the raw chronological list. Use it for a daily or weekly brief, or when the user asks what changed since a date. Price moves are not events here (see get_company). A Schedule 13D/G row carries `move` (crossed 5%, up, down, below 5% — no longer required to report, not a sale —, out) with `previousPercent` and `changeVsPrevious`; a 13F row carries `moves`, what that manager did with the tracked companies since its previous quarter. `complete: false` means a source had more items than were read: the summary is complete after `coversFrom`; narrow `since` or pass `symbol`.

detail.description: 'highlights' (default): ranked, grouped summary of the window. 'events': the raw list, newest first.

limit.description: Highlights: rows to return (default 40, max 100). Events: events to return (default 50, max 200).

since.description: ISO date or timestamp to look back from (default: 7 days ago, maximum 90 days).

symbol.description: Restrict to one ticker. Omit for the whole universe.

name: what_changed
title: Events since a date
